summary: Bill Gates co-founded Microsoft in 1975, built it into a software monopoly by crushing rivals, then used the Gates Foundation to steer global health and US schools by market logic, including defending vaccine patents during COVID-19.

evidence.note: birth and wealthy family background in Seattle
starts at Lakeside in 1968, school buys computer time
drops out of Harvard in 1975 to found Micro-Soft in Albuquerque
1976 open letter attacking hobbyists who shared his software
tying, bundling and sabotaging rival products such as Lotus
federal antitrust suit over Netscape, ruling and appeal, deposition
steps down as CEO in 2000 and turns to the foundation
grants to Monsanto for African farming framed as top-down imperialism
host calls foundation charity imperialism, turns to US school reform
2008 billion-dollar teacher evaluation push and failed small-schools drive
Epstein meetings from 2011 and the end of the marriage
ACT Accelerator and COVAX protecting vaccine IP in 2020-21

notes: Gates was alive at release, so main_span ends null and covered_span runs 1955-2021. Africa and the global South are discussed as harm places but mostly without named countries (Kenya only briefly), so setting is US with global scope. The host cut a segment on HIV circumcision programs after a correction. Workplace advances and Epstein ties are covered but not as sexual abuse by Gates, so no sexual-abuse theme.
